pillar_reactions.evidence: Call terminated during discovery. No pillar was delivered.
Never reached, despite the prospect naming nutrition as his single biggest challenge in his first answer: 'I would say it's about nutrition first, because I don't really know what to eat.'

anchors.raw: At first I was looking at calisthenic, because I feel this is something I want to be able to control my body. Yeah, and I feel calisthenic is a good way to do so, to feel light and being able to do what I want with my body. And I come across your program, and I said, yeah, why not?
anchors.note: Proposed label: zero_cost_modality_alternative. He arrived comparing the programme against calisthenics, which he can do for nothing and which he is actively researching. He is not price-anchored to a competing coach — he is anchored to the idea that this problem is solvable with free information, which is also why he had never hired anyone: 'I'm passionate about what I do, and I like to find by myself things and figure out by myself.' On the follow-up call five days later this resolved into a hard affordability wall, but at this point it reads as a value question rather than a money one.
